source: Oya… the poundin’ in my skull. I’ve hardly a voice either… What a feast, what a gut-bustin’ feast. Long live Chief Ondomon, eh? What all did I eat? Oysters, fried bass, seal filets, bark biscuits with sweet syrup, roasted pine nuts, and those wild strawberries and potatoes old Gavin found a way to grow in water. Mmmm, my good fella Kloss the Fuelman gave me seaweed rum to blow fire for the dancin’ – explains the sandiness in my throat and the gullshit taste in my mouth, heh. That Daneve sure can sing. Melodies smooth as oiled sardines and words that… that stay in the heart. And then, yeas, then I had the rainbow vision after her songs. Good ole mindbender mushrooms to watch the stars shoot across the dark. Last thing I remember is the dark. Oh, you fool Warek. Yous gettin’ too brittle in the bones to revel like you did in the dry world. Huh? What the… Oya! Some bumwit drew peckers and gonads all over me! Fungaki – that little minnowprick…
target: 噢呀……腦袋一陣陣地痛。連聲音都快沒了…… 好一場盛宴，吃得肚皮都快破了。翁多蒙首領萬歲，對吧？ 我到底吃了些啥？牡蠣、炸鱸魚、海豹肉片、淋甜糖漿的樹皮餅乾、烤松子，還有老蓋文想辦法種在水裡的野草莓和馬鈴薯。嗯……我的好兄弟燃料匠克洛斯，給了我海藻蘭姆酒，讓我在舞會上噴火——難怪喉嚨像塞了沙，嘴裡一股海鷗屎味，嘿。 丹妮芙真會唱。曲調像油漬沙丁魚那麼滑順，歌詞……會留在心裡。然後，對，她唱完，我就看見彩虹幻象。老朋友迷幻蘑菇，讓我看星星劃過黑暗。最後記得的，就是黑暗。 噢，瓦瑞克，你這笨蛋。骨頭愈來愈脆，不能再像乾地世界那時一樣狂歡了。 嗯？搞什麼……噢呀！哪個蠢蛋在我全身畫滿雞巴和蛋蛋！ 芬加奇——那個小魚崽子……

source: Queen Aryth : Bow your heads, insects of Aslandia – I am Aryth, Queen of the shallow seas, Conqueror of the great cement towers of New York and Philadelphia and the District known as Columbia. Behold my barge of wonder, the length of 100 men with sails of red silk and anchors of gold. Witness my great horde of life, my floating nation, rich beyond dreams in fine metals, jewels, knowledge, slaves, and beasts. That you have seen this marvel is the greatest achievement of your insignificant lives. My mystics unravel the secrets of time, energy, and all that which is too small to see or feel. My apothecaries can cause and cure a thousand ills, and my tinkerers can make metal so intricate that it dances to its own music. Now look around at the war rafts surrounding your tribe and see Arythian Crossbowmen with bolts of fire. See iron-armored Furions, unrelenting warriors of my divine fury. You are nothing to them. Aslandia – your survival in the vastness of the seas is… curious. You will relinquish your treasures and secrets. My loyal Furions, take this mockery of religion called Seece and feed my three snow bears. Let their white coats turn as red as our sails tonight.
target: 艾瑞絲女王：低下你們的頭，阿斯蘭迪亞的蟲子——我是艾瑞絲，淺海女王，征服紐約、費城，以及那個名為哥倫比亞的特區之宏偉水泥高塔的人。 瞻仰我的奇蹟巨舫，長達百人，紅絲為帆，黃金為錨。見證我龐大的生靈軍團，我漂浮的國度，擁有超乎夢想的精美金屬、珠寶、知識、奴隸與猛獸。得見這番奇觀，便是你們微不足道的一生中最偉大的成就。 我的祕術師解開時間、能量，以及一切微小到無法看見或感知之物的奧祕。我的藥師能引發、也能治癒千百種疾病；我的巧匠能把金屬製作得如此精妙，讓它隨自己的音樂起舞。 現在，看看包圍你們部落的戰筏，看那些備有火箭的艾瑞絲弩手。看身披鐵甲的弗里昂，我神聖怒火下永不退卻的戰士。在他們眼裡，你們什麼都不是。 阿斯蘭迪亞——你們竟能在浩瀚海洋中生存……倒是有趣。你們將交出財寶與祕密。 我忠誠的弗里昂，把這個叫希絲、褻瀆宗教的笑話，拿去餵我的三頭雪熊。今夜，讓牠們的白毛變得和我們的帆一樣紅。

source: Oya, just when yous think you seen it all, snails the size of sealions appear in the distance pulling a group of land rafts – “sledges,” they’s called. Am I on mindbenders? Just look at them massive, purple shells… their two sets of slimy eyes, the ones on top their head as long as my arm, stretching and bendin’ around. My eyes are goin’ sore – I’m rubbing ‘em near raw! Everyone else is also blinkin’ in unbelief. What’s the biggest snail I seen around here? Maybe three feets tall? And these beasts be taller than any man, and movin’ at the speed of a fast walk – all while pullin’ loads! Some of us gettin’ scared this is Aryth comin’ for revenge, others gettin’ hopeful it’s Daneve doin’ another unthinkable miracle. My gut got a queasy feelin’. Well gullshit – Look at these tracks in the mud. Two fists deep. All from the biggest sledge, hauled by four great snails. A long pole coming out the back with a purple flag – what looks like a picture of a snail shell filled with spears on it. Strange-lookin’ tribe. Got their hair made up into a puff, like they copying the look of snail shells. Must be about as many of them as there is of us. Fungaki goes and greets their leader, who ain’t wanna get off his sledge and walk in the mud. I gotta know… there, that snail handler’s lookin’ bored, “Oya, how yous got these snail beasts?” Can hardly trust my hearing. He says he breeds ‘em for size, speed and purpose, like for work and war. Apparently snails only take a few months to mature, so it goes fast. He says their empire done this across many, many years… they’re “emissaries” lookin’ for a foothold to keep expandin’ empire business…
target: 噢呀，就在你以為啥都見過的時候，遠處竟冒出海獅那麼大的蝸牛，拉著一群陸地木筏——他們叫那玩意兒「拖橇」。 我吃了迷幻菇嗎？瞧瞧那些巨大的紫殼……兩對黏糊糊的眼睛，頭頂那對跟我手臂一樣長，伸來彎去。眼睛都揉疼了——快揉破皮啦！其他人也都難以置信地眨著眼。 我在這裡見過最大的蝸牛有多大？大概三呎高？可這些巨獸比誰都高，走得跟人快步走一樣快——還拉著貨呢！ 有些人怕是艾瑞絲回來報仇，有些人盼著是丹妮芙又做出了不可思議的奇蹟。我肚子裡卻一陣不安。 海鷗屎啊——瞧瞧泥裡的痕跡。兩個拳頭深。都是那輛最大的拖橇壓的，由四頭巨蝸拉著。後方伸出長桿，掛一面紫旗——上面像是畫著一個插滿長矛的蝸牛殼。 長得真奇怪的部落。頭髮盤成鼓鼓的一團，像在學蝸牛殼。人數大概和我們差不多。 芬加奇去迎接他們的首領，那傢伙卻不肯下拖橇，踩進泥裡。 我非得問清楚……那邊，那個馭蝸人看起來挺無聊，「噢呀，你們哪來這些蝸牛巨獸？」 真不敢相信自己的耳朵。他說，他按體型、速度和用途來繁殖牠們，像是工作、打仗。據說蝸牛幾個月就成年，所以育種很快。 他說，他們帝國幹這行好多好多年了……他們是「使節」，要找個落腳處，繼續擴張帝國的生意……

source:
March 12, 1784

Most Honorable Nathaniel Asbury, 

I believe it proper and necessary to extend my gratitude for your volunteerism and valor
target:
1784 年 3 月 12 日

至為尊敬的納撒尼爾・阿斯伯里：

我認為，理當且必須向您致謝，感謝您自願挺身而出，英勇奉獻，

source:
during our War of Independence. Word of your extraordinary leadership, of your “Deathless” exploits, reached me years ago. Indeed, the mythic tales of your ambush stratagems proved invaluable to various regiments of the Continental Army. ‘Twas a spark for their enfeebled morale during the struggles of the 1780 campaigns. 

Enclosed herein is a Charter recognizing the territory of your town that shall forthwith be renamed to Asbury, in the honor of your leadership and achievements: 

Thwarting death on numerous occasions, including attempted assassinations by British spies, numerous bounties on your head, and escape from the burning of your home.
target:
在我國獨立戰爭期間為國效力。您卓越的領導才能，以及「不死者」的功績，多年前便已傳入我耳中。事實上，關於您伏擊戰術的傳奇故事，對大陸軍各團都極有價值。在 1780 年戰役的艱困奮鬥中，那是點燃低迷士氣的一道火光。

隨函附上特許狀，確認貴鎮領土，並即刻將其更名為阿斯伯里，以表彰您的領導及下列成就：

屢次逃過死亡，包括英國間諜的暗殺、多次針對您人頭的懸賞，以及從燃燒的家園中脫身。

source:
Skirmishes in the pine woods that routed key British trade and supply lines seeking to arm enemy native tribes on our frontier borders. 

Securing an alliance with the regional Cherokee chief against an irregular and criminal force of light dragoons. 

Instilling hope in, and offering protection to, many innocents. 

I credit your bravery and unique legend in aiding our efforts to free our united colonies. ‘Tis my hope that your talents find a new home as the first mayor of the town of Asbury. 

Your very humble servant, 
George Washington
target:
在松林中的小規模戰鬥，擊潰英軍重要的貿易與補給路線，阻止其向邊境的敵對原住民部落提供武器。

與當地切羅基首領結盟，對抗一支不受規範、作惡多端的輕龍騎兵部隊。

為眾多無辜者帶來希望，並提供保護。

您的英勇與獨特傳奇，有助於我們解放聯合殖民地的努力，我對此深表肯定。願您的才幹，能以阿斯伯里鎮首任鎮長之姿，找到新的用武之地。

您最謙卑的僕人，
喬治・華盛頓
